'''KF Kamjani''' ({{langx|mk|ФК Камјан}}, ''FK Kamjan'') is a [[Association football|football]] club based in the village of [[Kamenjane|Kamenjane]] near [[Tetovo]], [[North Macedonia]]. They are currently competing in the [[Macedonian Third Football League|Macedonian Third League]] (West Division)."}}
